Title: Announcing the public preview of Azure Automanage

Body.Content:
What is Azure Automanage?

Azure Automanage helps customers significantly reduce day-to-day management tasks with automated operations across the entire lifecycle of Windows Server virtual machines in Azure. IT Admins can now manage their VMs with point-and-click simplicity, individually or at scale.

How does Azure Automanage work?

Azure Automanage automatically implements VM management best practices for business continuity and security as defined in the Azure Cloud Adoption Framework. If the VM's configuration drifts from the applied best practices, Azure Automanage will detect and automatically bring the VM back to the desired configuration.

Join the preview.

Read the blog.

Learn more.
